task_title: Floor 2 industrial-cave harvestables, ambient lighting, and props

plan_review.notes: Plan reviewed via issue comment on #1903 before any code was written. Design adopted existing infrastructure (propPlacer, harvestSystem, decorationDefs) with a new cave BiomeTag. No alternative approaches required rework — single-file, append-only registry extensions with clear boundary constants. Convergent: the three-bucket design (harvestables+lighting+props) maps cleanly to existing systems with no architectural forks required.

rounds.summary: Critical regression found and fixed: spawnFloor1HarvestableNodes iterated the full HARVESTABLE_DEFS array (0..length-1) which, after adding Floor 2 defs at indices 6-8, would spawn iron-vein, copper-seam, and gem-cluster nodes on Floor 1. Fixed by: (1) exporting FLOOR2_HARVESTABLE_START_INDEX=6 from harvestableDefs.ts as a shared boundary constant, (2) capping the Floor 1 spawner loop at defIndex < FLOOR2_HARVESTABLE_START_INDEX, (3) removing the redundant local re-declaration of FLOOR2_HARVESTABLE_START_INDEX from floor2Scenario.ts and importing the shared one, (4) adding a regression test asserting Floor 1 scenario produces zero nodes with defIndex>=6. No further concerns raised.
